title: ID0448732-DC/Si-D/DE[MP / R0 170002838] Charging issue
description:
Reported issue:
One of our drivers reports that he connected his Scania to the LS10 at around 2:45 p.m. with a charge level of 31%, and this morning shortly after 5:00 a.m., he found his truck with a charge level of 27%. Scanias are usually unproblematic. The so-called “wake-up charging” should have kicked in here, right?
08-09-2025 10:45
Solution: Change TxStopPoint to PowerPathClosed
yyyy-mm-dd: NA

additional_info.subject: ID0448732-DC/Si-D/DE[MP / R0 170002838] Charging issue CRM:02678000362
additional_info.body:
Hello Ralph,
Thank you for the feedback.
The wake-up function can only be enabled starting with version 8.0.5. However, for this function to work properly, a configuration value needs to be set on our backend. After I set this configuration once, it is no longer required to change ever again.
Only in brand new chargers this comes configuration is by default.
Please let me know if you want me to apply this configuration to all the chargers.
Thank you!
Best regards,
Francisco

additional_info.subject: ID0448732-DC/Si-D/DE[MP / R0 170002838] Charging issue CRM:02678000362
additional_info.body:
Hello Ralph,
I checked the sessions and I find that the eActross is not doing the wake-up function itself:
For LS3
As you can see, we start the session with A -> B2 (connected and ready) and the last E -> B1 is when the session is stopped.
How the wake-up function works is 100% on the EV side, in software terms, we need to see after the E -> B1 something like B1 -> B2 or B1  -> C2, followed by a C2 -> B2, and this makes the charger start again, but since the EV didn't send this communication, we are not going to start again.
For LS5 is the same behaviour:
We stopped the session in the E -> B1 and the EV never send us the request again.
For the LS3 with SoC=72% I couldn't find any session that stopped yesterday for LS3 at 72%, can you please confirm if it was really in LS3?
For the LS9, I see the problem and we will convey this information to the Field service team for support and solution.
For the eActros, it is required to need a statement from Daimler as this falls entirely on the EV to restart the sessions.
I will create a new ticket since this one has been already closed. They will follow up in the new ticket which I will send the email soon.
Thank you and have a nice weekend.
Best regards,
Francisco
